info.title: Glossarist Vocab API — event and streaming surface
info.description: AsyncAPI description of the streaming and event-driven surfaces of the Glossarist vocabulary service. The REST surface is described separately (OpenAPI at /openapi.json).

production.description: Production deployment (custom domain; workers.dev fallback serves the same documents).

mcpStreamableHttp.description: Model Context Protocol over Streamable HTTP: the client POSTs JSON-RPC 2.0 messages; the server responds either with a single JSON response or, for streaming-capable requests, an SSE (text/event-stream) channel carrying JSON-RPC messages. Protocol version negotiated at initialize (2026-07-28, fallback 2025-06-18).

jsonRpcResponse.title: JSON-RPC 2.0 response (or SSE event over the stream)

sseEvent.title: Server-Sent Events channel
sseEvent.description: When the server answers with an event stream, each SSE `data:` event carries one JSON-RPC response message (schema: jsonRpcResponse). The stream terminates per the MCP Streamable HTTP rules.

registerBuildPublished.description: Webhook (planned, editorial workflow milestone): fired when a new build is ingested and the served indexes + static site flip to it. Subscribers: federation harvesters (DCAT re-harvest), CI caches, downstream replicas. Delivery: HTTP POST, JSON body, HMAC-SHA256 signature header (X-Glossarist-Signature) against the subscriber's shared secret; at-least-once with exponential-backoff retries for 24h.

dcat.description: URL of the refreshed DCAT catalogue

proposalStateChanged.description: Webhook (planned, editorial workflow milestone): fired on every ISO 19135 proposal state transition (draft → submitted → under-review → accepted / rejected / withdrawn). Subscribers: proposal authors, control-body watchers, notification fan-out.
